contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, possibly Trier mint Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, possibly RIC vol. 8 page 152, type as nos 207-211. Obverse inscription: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths, a fir tree between the Victories.
